# WHY RACING EVENTS

> WHY RACING EVENTS is a Pacific Northwest race production company based in La Center, WA, founded in 2014 (its Girlfriends Run dates to 2006). Its calendar lists 21 annual running, trail and triathlon events (5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon, ultra, sprint/Olympic triathlon) across Washington and Oregon: 14 produced by WHY RACING EVENTS and 7 by partners Bivouac Racing and X-Dog Adventures. The brand has supported $3M+ in charitable giving.

## Events

- [Battle to the Pacific](https://whyracingevents.com/events/battle-to-the-pacific.md): Hammond, OR (2026-11-21).
- [Ho Ho 5K](https://whyracingevents.com/events/ho-ho-5k.md): Portland, OR (2026-12-06).

- [Resolution Run](https://whyracingevents.com/events/resolution-run.md): La Center, WA (2027-01-09).
- [White River Snow Shoe](https://whyracingevents.com/events/white-river-snow-shoe.md): Government Camp, OR (2027-01-31).

- [Bigfoot 5K/10K](https://whyracingevents.com/events/bigfoot-5k-10k.md): Yacolt, WA (2027-07-04).

- [Girlfriends Half Marathon, 10K & 6K](https://whyracingevents.com/events/girlfriends-half-marathon-10k-6k.md): Vancouver, WA (2027-10-10).
